name: Network Security Event – Qualification
description:
## 🎯 Purpose
Triaging network security alerts (IPS, scanning, illegal methods) to rule out false positives and authorized activity.

---

## 📌 Objectives
1. Rule out maintenance/Change Requests.
2. Verify telemetry via IPS, Proxy, and Zeek logs.
3. Profile Malicious Actors/APT indicators.

tasks.title: Task 1: Infrastructure & Change Control Context
tasks.description:
### 🎯 Objective
Rule out authorized internal activity.
### 📌 Actions
* Check source IP against internal vulnerability scanners.
* **Verify if activity matches an active/recent Change Request (CR).**
* Confirm if destination port/service is standard for this host.
### ✅ Deliverables
* Activity status (Authorized/Unauthorized).

tasks.title: Task 2: Layer 7 & Traffic Analysis
tasks.description:
### 🎯 Objective
Inspect payloads for malicious intent using available logs.
### 📌 Actions
* Review **IPS/IDS** signatures for specific exploit violations.
* Analyze **Web Proxy** logs for URI patterns and illegal HTTP methods.
* Review **Zeek** connection logs for flow anomalies.
### ✅ Deliverables
* Technical summary of traffic legitimacy.

tasks.title: Task 3: Outcome & Success Verification
tasks.description:
### 🎯 Objective
Determine if the attempt was successful.
### 📌 Actions
* Cross-reference SIEM alerts with destination host logs (e.g., 200 OK vs 403 Forbidden).
* Check for successful auth or follow-up commands post-event.
### ✅ Deliverables
* Outcome status (Blocked, Failed, or Allowed).

tasks.title: Task 4: Malicious Actor & APT Profiling
tasks.description:
### 🎯 Objective
Identify the threat actor.
### 📌 Actions
* Perform lookups via Threat Intel for **Malicious Actor** history.
* Correlate with known **APT** indicators or tactics (TTPs).
### ✅ Deliverables
* Actor profile and attribution notes.
